# Quantum Parallel Marked Set

The project studies exact identification of a marked set from one simultaneous
layer of ordinary phase-oracle calls. The number of marks is supplied.

Scientific routes

- README.md: question, principal results and navigation.
- science/model.md: authoritative oracle model, resources and statement scope.
- science/moment-design.md: parity symmetrization, exact rational feasibility,
  two-layer one-mark construction and finite examples.
- science/asymptotics.md: fixed-mark Laguerre law, lower bound polynomial,
  positive bracketing and finite endpoint for the even-moment construction.
- science/receiver.md: signed incidence multipliers, explicit Schur-transform
  decoder, address routing and known-gate resource bounds.
- references/RELATED_WORK.md and references/references.bib: provenance.
- verification/README.md: commands and scope of executable checks.

Learning routes

- learning/CHILDS_BRIDGE.md: Andrew M. Childs's 17 April 2025 Lecture Notes
  on Quantum Algorithms, selected sections and worked translations.
- learning/MILESTONES.md: 30 shared milestones, with 12 background and
  18 project-specific milestones.

Read the model before comparing with a bit oracle, controlled phase access,
multi-round enumeration or a circuit-depth benchmark. The finite program
covers every supplied admissible cardinality. The Laguerre expansion takes
the large-address limit at a fixed number of marks. For balanced weight,
complementary sets implement the same phase channel.
